description: Defines structures, function prototypes, and constants related to the 'fetch-pack' operation in a Git-like version control system, including fetch arguments, negotiation, and object integrity checks.

methods.name: fetch_pack
methods.description: Performs the fetch operation based on provided arguments, updating references and handling pack negotiation.

methods.name: negotiate_using_fetch
methods.description: Executes negotiation-only mode of fetch, adding known commits to acknowledged set.

methods.name: report_unmatched_refs
methods.description: Reports refs that were not matched during fetch.

methods.name: fetch_pack_fsck_objects
methods.description: Checks if broken objects in received pack need to be verified.
